calendar.new_holdout: NONE_RESERVED; freeze prospectively before any model fitting; no new acquisition beyond cutoff
calendar.already_viewed: All QR001/QR003 windows; all newly expanded data is development/retrospective for this phase

sources.fallback: Official same-venue same-product API/archive only with explicit provenance and overlap conflict checks; no bypass of unavailable/denied sources

intake_budget.request_count_rule: 450 total network attempts including failed attempts, retries, redirects, probes and final overlap checks; retries never multiply budget

normalization.exact_duplicate_policy: deduplicate identical parsed numeric records, retain all source references in lineage/quarantine ledger
normalization.conflict_policy: quarantine all conflicting versions; never overwrite/select last or average
normalization.gap_policy: report every missing interval; no forward_fill/interpolate/zero funding; no silent date shrink
normalization.outlier_policy: flag for source verification; never clip real crashes
normalization.cross_interval_policy: check 1h aggregates against independently sourced4h/1d as QC only, do not replace inputs
normalization.boundary_policy: exclude candles whose close exceeds cutoff and funding at/after cutoff

manifest_contract.path_rule: relative beneath explicit dataset root; no traversal/symlink escape; raw/ normalized/ quarantine/ are separate immutable partitions
manifest_contract.metadata_rule: current snapshots retained separately; observed_at actual retrieval, historical_effective_at null unless documented; never backdate current multiplier/tier/funding_interval

warmup.funding_interval_rule: retain observed inter-settlement durations and document interval schedule; distinguish schedule change from missing record; unresolved regime/gap prevents unchanged constant-interval replay

preconditions: no unresolved required-input conflict or gap in warmup/scored range
same unchanged QR003 research config; frozen metadata approximation explicitly acknowledged
historical interval schedule compatible with native single interval or blocker reported
baseline_label_budget.state_policy: one uninterrupted account per coin; no fold resets or forced split exits; bankruptcy/terminal censoring retained
baseline_label_budget.label_policy: reuse QR003 actual exit cash-flow accounting; terminal/missing/unknown labels null; actual label_end plus86400 strictly before next stage

readiness.G1_raw: all raw/source/status/hash/decompression/row integrity checks pass; failures retained
readiness.G2_normalized: exact universe/product/units/closed-time/cutoff; zero unresolved conflicts or missing required intervals; proven lineage; actual funding plus declared interval semantics; realistic arrival caveat
readiness.G3_events: full warmup, permitted two baselines, label quality and maturity checked; each asset has identifiable nonconstant targets/features and multiple separated market periods; report cross-asset/time clusters and uncertainty; bars/branches never independent label counts
readiness.G4_protocol: proposed chronological splits, six named features, one fixed linear model and train-prior documented; no fit; prospective holdout and economic effect/precision acceptance remain explicit decisions at training confirmation
readiness.G5_permission: fresh direct user confirmation immediately before training
readiness.ready_status: READY_FOR_USER_TRAINING_CONFIRMATION means G1-G3 supported and G4 proposal reviewable, not generalization proven; final G4 choices and fresh G5 required before any fit
readiness.otherwise: NOT_READY with exact missing coverage or evidence, never grow search until profitability

proposed_training_only.model: ridge linear regression, fixed alpha1, train-only zscore, intercept
comparators: training mean for same exit target
proposed_training_only.target: natural exit net_pnl / initial actual filled_notional, conditional continuation policy
proposed_training_only.candidate_gate: predicted net return >0; threshold fixed before fit
proposed_training_only.uncertainty: paired common-calendar time blocks across assets; disclose cluster dependence and interval width; required economic effect and acceptable interval width must be accepted at training-confirmation decision
